dev-001.title: Remote Code Execution via crafted OSPF packet
dev-001.description: A vulnerability in the OSPF packet processing of MeridianOS XE allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code on the affected device.

dev-001.title: Privilege escalation via crafted CLI command
dev-001.description: A vulnerability in the CLI of MeridianOS XE allows a low-privileged authenticated user to escalate privileges to root level.

dev-001.title: Denial of service via malformed BGP update
dev-001.description: A vulnerability in the BGP implementation of MeridianOS XE could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to cause a device to reload unexpectedly.

dev-001.title: Information disclosure in SNMP MIB handler
dev-001.description: A vulnerability in the SNMP subsystem of MeridianOS XE could allow an authenticated remote attacker to obtain sensitive device configuration data.

dev-001.title: Buffer overflow in HTTP server request handler
dev-001.description: A vulnerability in the HTTP server of MeridianOS XE could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to cause a buffer overflow condition.

dev-001.title: Unauthenticated REST API access to device config
dev-001.description: A vulnerability in the REST API of MeridianOS XE allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to read or modify the device configuration.

dev-001.title: Memory leak in IPv6 RA guard feature
dev-001.description: A vulnerability in the IPv6 RA guard feature of MeridianOS XE could allow an unauthenticated adjacent attacker to cause a memory leak on the device.
